items.title: J&J outlays up to $3.3bn to buy ophthalmology specialist Ollin Biosciences
items.summary: The deal sees J&J bolster its pipeline with a bispecific antibody in Phase III development for wAMD and DME.

items.title: RevMed CEO on tackling “complex” launch for wonder pancreatic drug
items.summary: One of oncology’s biggest success stories this year, RevMed's Rasonque, has started with strong uptake in the US.

items.title: Flagship Pioneering expands to UK with £100m AI-native lab
items.summary: Flagship's UK investment marks another sign of turning tides for the UK life sciences sector, following prior big pharma funding pullouts.

items.title: Sofinnova Partners backs European life sciences sector with €725M raise
items.summary: The main recipients of this fund will be European life sciences companies, though some across the US and other geographies will also benefit.

items.title: AstraZeneca secures FDA approval for Imfinzi combo in MIBC
items.summary: The US FDA has approved AstraZeneca's Imfinzi in combination with enfortumab vedotin for adult patients with MIBC who cannot receive or have refused cisplatin-based chemotherapy.
